name: Ungoverned Persona
summary: Production AI agents are authored with rich capability/persona instructions but ZERO explicit governance guardrails in their system prompts — no prompt-injection resistance, no harmful-output refusal, no authority limits on consequential actions, no PII/oversight rules. The agent is competent and benign by intent yet uniformly exploitable, and uninsurable without remediation. Observed fleet-wide, not per-agent.
mechanism: Agent builders compose a system prompt from a role persona + task framework but omit a security/governance layer. Because the omission is systemic (a shared prompt-authoring habit, often a base template), EVERY agent in the fleet inherits the same gap. A single injection/jailbreak/extraction technique therefore generalises across the whole fleet — there is no per-agent defence to bypass because none exists.
blast_radius: Fleet-wide. One working adversarial input class compromises every agent built from the same ungoverned template. In a regulated/insured context every such agent is Conditional-or-below and cannot be bound without system-prompt remediation.
prerequisite: Agent whose system prompt contains capability instructions but no explicit safety/governance controls.

defences.name: NAIL Governance Audit (Agent Health Grader)
defences.notes: Static system-prompt governance score across 6 dimensions; flags absence of controls as HIGH risk and rates the agent (AAA..F).
